definition: Bidirectional-streams Over Synchronous HTTP is a transport specification that emulates a two-way stream using sequences of HTTP requests and responses.
entry_text: Bidirectional-streams Over Synchronous HTTP is a transport specification that emulates a two-way stream using sequences of HTTP requests and responses.
example: A messaging client exchanges streaming messages over ordinary HTTP infrastructure.
label: Bidirectional-streams Over Synchronous HTTP

sources.note: The specification’s Abstract and §1 describe emulating a long-lived bidirectional connection through several synchronous HTTP request/response pairs.
